articles.title: The 65" Samsung S90F 4K QD-OLED TV Is Better Than Its 2026 Successor, and It's on Sale for Labor Day
articles.summary: The best gaming TV just dropped in price during eBay's annual Labor Day Sale. For a limited time, Electronic Express is offering the 65" Samsung S90F 4K OLED Smart TV for just $1,038.39 with free shipping when you apply 20% off coupon code " LABORDAY20 ".
body: The S90F is the 2025 model in Samsung's S90 OLED TV lineup. This is the last TV in the S90 series that's equipped with a quantum dot OLED panel. This year, Samsung decided to remove quantum dot technology from the S90 series, which means the only way to get a QD-OLED TV in 2026 is splurging for the S95H TV. The 65" S95H TV sells for $2,800.

The S90F is equipped with Samsung's coveted quantum dot OLED panel which delivers a brighter picture and richer colors than W-OLED panels (like the one found in the S90H) while retaining all of the other benefits of OLED: near instaneous response time, true black levels, near infinite contrast ratio, and outstanding viewing angles. The Samsung S90F also has the features you'd want in a gaming TV, including a native 120Hz panel and HDMI 2.1 ports so you can run PlayStation 5 or Xbox Series X games in 4K resolution at up to 120fps.
points: The best gaming TV just dropped in price during eBay's annual Labor Day Sale.

articles.title: AMC Theaters Launches Its Own Film Distribution Company As Small Budget Movies Soar
articles.summary: AMC Theaters isn’t merely a destination for watching new film releases; it now helps make those releases happen. Launched on August 31, 2026, AMC has rolled out Leawood Films, its very own movie distribution label that aims to bring small or mid-sized flicks to the big screen that have been…
body: Speaking in a press release, AMC Entertainment chairman and CEO Adam Aron cited moviegoers’ increasing appetites for independent films.

“Ultimately, moviegoers consistently demonstrate their appetite for a wide variety of theatrical content, and we believe there are more outstanding films that deserve the opportunity to find audiences on the big screen,” he said. “Through Leawood Films, we believe we can bring meaningful value to filmmakers whose movies might otherwise not get made, or which might not be taken to theatres.

“We can assure them the availability of movie theatre screens and attractive economics, as well as have them benefit from our relationships across the exhibition industry, our proven marketing capabilities, and our extensive experience connecting theatrical content with moviegoing audiences.”

articles.title: Godzilla Remaster Devs Explain Why They Aren’t Worried About Releasing Near GTA 6
articles.summary: Most upcoming games have looked to steer clear of the behemoth that is Grand Theft Auto 6 and avoid the month of November entirely. The upcoming remaster of 2002's Godzilla Destroy All Monsters Melee is a notable exception, and as it turns out, the developers didn't think about GTA 6 at all when…
body: In an interview with IGN, senior designer at developer Pipeworks Simon Strange revealed GTA's looming release of November 16 wasn't a factor when choosing Godzilla Destroy All Monsters Melee: Remastered's November 3 release date.

Like others online, the development team got a kick out of kaiju fans celebrating the fact that the King of the Monsters (and Barbie) were the only two pop culture icons brave enough to face off against developer Rockstar's open-world juggernaut.

"Honestly, [it] wasn't even in our heads at all when we were picking the release date," Strange said. "That's not my business. I make the video games. I'm not too worried about when they come out. If Atari had come to us and said, 'Wow, we can't because we think it's going to affect the sales with GTA', we would've had that discussion. But no one ever said anything."
points: Most upcoming games have looked to steer clear of the behemoth that is Grand Theft Auto 6 and avoid the month of November entirely.

articles.title: Gal Gadot Says James Gunn and Peter Safran Told Her Wonder Woman 3 Was Happening Before Its Messy Cancellation
articles.summary: Former DC movie star Gal Gadot has opened up about the confusion surrounding Wonder Woman 3, saying that, even though it "wasn't handled elegantly," it's "all good" between her, James Gunn, and Peter Safran. The story of Wonder Woman 3 is a bit of a mess.
body: One of the stranger updates during the kerfuffle saw the actress confirm the two superhero film execs had told her she would come back as Diana Prince for Wonder Woman 3 before it was reported that Gunn and Safran didn't have any plans for a third movie from director Patty Jenkins after all. It was a back-and-forth painful enough to watch from the outside, but it was probably even more grueling on the inside.

Gadot recalled the confusion during an interview with Happy, Sad, Confused. She again confirmed that Gunn and Safran assured her Wonder Woman 3 was happening, going as far as to say that there was never a clear moment when the project was formally canned.

"No, they told me the opposite," she answered when asked about the circumstances surrounding the cancellation. "They were like, 'We're going to develop it with you, [Wonder Woman 3], but I saw the way everybody else was handled, right?"

articles.title: The Blood of Dawnwalker PC Settings Guide: Maximize Your PC Performance By Tweaking These Options
articles.summary: While 2026 has so far been packed with incredible PC games, The Blood of Dawnwalker was the one that I was looking forward to the most. Not only does it come from a game director with an incredible pedigree, but ever since system requirements were first revealed in February, I knew that this game…
body: Luckily, Rebel Wolves has since lightened the system requirements a bit, now only recommending an RTX 4070 Ti for 4K 60 fps gameplay, rather than the RTX 5090 I thought it was going to require at the beginning of the year. And now that I’ve had a chance to play it, I’m pleasantly surprised at its performance, even if the visuals are a little mixed.

Just like a lot of RPGs of this scope, much of what makes The Blood of Dawnwalker so beautiful is its environments. Just walking through the town and the forest in the opening chapter is jaw-dropping, with realistic foliage and water. The character models don’t quite reach the same fidelity, but I’m ok with that when just walking through the world looks as good as it does.

While The Blood of Dawnwalker is available on Xbox Series X and PlayStation 5, PC is where it truly shines. This game has pretty much every graphics option I’d like in a modern game, and avoids clumping a bunch of graphics techniques into one banner. The game is quite heavy to run maxed out, but there is genuinely enough room to dial it in for better performance, pretty much whichever hardware you’re playing it on.
points: While 2026 has so far been packed with incredible PC games, The Blood of Dawnwalker was the one that I was looking forward to the most.

articles.summary: The video game industry explodes into life this September, with a deluge of exciting new releases as publishers hustle to release their titles well clear of the oncoming juggernaut that is Grand Theft Auto 6.
body: In September, Switch 2 gets two very tasty exclusives — one of them a hotly anticipated new entry in a fan-favorite Nintendo franchise. There are also three AAA third-party games releasing day one on Switch 2, and one sequel to a much-loved indie.

The six games listed below are just the most anticipated all-new releases, too. A ton of cool ports hit Switch 2 in September 2, including Lego Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight, survival games Valheim and RuneScape: Dragonwilds, action games Hell is Us and Shinobi: Art of Vengeance, and classic RPG with very long title Dragon Quest 11 S: Echoes of an Elusive Age — Definitive Edition.

2018's Moonlighter is a much-loved indie that combines a cozy shopkeeping game with a Zelda-inspired dungeon-crawler. By night, you explore dungeons and collect materials to craft and sell in your shop during the daytime. For this new sequel, developer Digital Sun moves from a 2D presentation to a 3D isometric view, and draws heavy inspiration from Hades in its action-roguelite gameplay.

articles.title: “Trust Us–We’re Remedy:” Control Resonant Will Have Plenty Of Lore, The Devs Just Can’t Reveal Any Of It
articles.summary: Fear not, Control fans: Control Resonant will be packed with lore despite the combat-heavy trailers we've seen so far, according to developer Remedy. The lack of focus on story in promotional footage, says Remedy senior communications manager Miika Huttunen, is no reflection of the game's content…
body: The sneak peeks we've had of the game so far have been mainly combat-focused, a result of combat being something that doesn't need to be revealed gradually to the player. "There's lots of weird stuff to come," says Huttunen, "plenty of twists and turns and surprises… things to discover. We're asking fans to trust us--we're Remedy. And I hope that, because we're Remedy, we get the benefit of the doubt."

Lore-related collectibles, like FBC documents and written materials from pre-Hiss-invasion times, are scattered liberally throughout the game. It pays to explore and take your time finding secrets, as the world of Control Resonant is no less carefully crafted than its predecessor, and the story is far from an afterthought. Besides the written word, you'll also find countless places where you can open shortcuts, unpack subtle environmental clues, and have interactions with NPCs who help to expand your understanding of the world.
points: Fear not, Control fans: Control Resonant will be packed with lore despite the combat-heavy trailers we've seen so far, according to developer Remedy.

articles.title: The Bizarre Cult Sci-fi Classic ‘Donnie Darko’ Is Now Free to Watch
articles.summary: A cult classic isn't necessarily a movie everyone loved when it came out. Sometimes it's the movie that found its audience years later — passed around between friends, endlessly quoted, rediscovered on late-night cable, and eventually embraced by a devoted group of fans.
body: Some are straightforward genre favorites, like The Evil Dead or The Warriors. Others are considerably stranger. Heathers, Napoleon Dynamite, and The Rocky Horror Picture Show all have wildly different sensibilities, but they share that same ability to inspire the kind of devotion that turns a movie into something bigger than its original release.

Richard Kelly's Donnie Darko is now available to watch for free on YouTube, giving anyone who somehow missed the 2001 cult classic a chance to see one of the strangest and most enduring movies of its era without paying for a rental or subscription.

Donnie Darko follows Donnie Darko (Jake Gyllenhaal), a troubled teenager living with his family in suburban Virginia. One night, Donnie is visited by a mysterious figure named Frank wearing a creepy rabbit costume. Frank tells him that the world will end in 28 days, setting Donnie on a bizarre path involving time travel, alternate realities and an increasingly complicated series of events that may or may not be connected.
The movie features an unusually stacked cast for an offbeat sci-fi drama, including Jena Malone, Maggie Gyllenhaal, Drew Barrymore, Patrick Swayze, Seth Rogen, and Mary McDonnell.

articles.title: Xbox Officially Has 4 GOTY Contenders Coming in September
articles.summary: September will see an absolute deluge of new video game releases across all platforms, and Xbox is no exception. It's been a turbulent summer for Microsoft's gaming platform, with another hefty hike to hardware prices beginning Aug.
body: For those searching for a bit of distraction to offset all that grim news, there's a heaping helping of new games to play. Many of these come from third-party developers like Capcom, CD Projekt Red, and Remedy Entertainment, though the Microsoft-owned Mojang is in the mix with a new Minecraft spin-off at the end of the month. We'll have to wait a little bit longer for big-ticket Xbox exclusives like Gears of War: E-Day (Oct. 6) and the new Fable (Feb. 23, 2027). That said, Xbox players have plenty of exciting new games to sink their teeth into this September, including several titles that are already generating Game of the Year buzz. Here are a few of our top picks.

Fancy a little romance? This open-world, dark fantasy RPG developed by a team of ex- Witcher 3 devs features multiple potential love interests and dedicated questlines. You'll play as Coen, a broody, man-bunned fellow in 14th-century central Europe. He's a human by day, vampire by night. During the course of the story, you'll be forced to choose whether to preserve your humanity or preserve your cursed powers. It's great to have options, but embracing the path of a himbo bloodsucker seems like the most fun.

articles.title: A September 10 Nintendo Direct Is Looking Likely Thanks To Just Dance
articles.summary: Fans eager to see what Nintendo is cooking up for the 2026 holiday season might not have to wait long, as new evidence is making a September 10 Nintendo Direct look likely. That evidence in question is Just Dance: Decades of Hits.
body: "We're committed to sharing the complete picture with you on September 10, and we sincerely thank you for your patience and continued support in the meantime," Ubisoft's statement reads.

As highlighted by Nintendo Everything, Just Dance titles frequently appear during Nintendo Directs, with last year's Just Dance 2026 Edition announced during a summer presentation. Nintendo also has a history of premiering a Nintendo Direct ahead of the Tokyo Game Show, which kicks off on September 17 this year.

The September 10 date then is looking promising, especially when combined with Nintendo's previous history. We recently explained why a September Nintendo Direct is likely to happen; there has been an early-to-mid September Nintendo Direct almost every year for the past decade (with a late August direct in 2024 being the one exception).
We'll know if the September 10 date is real by September 9 at the latest, as Nintendo has a history of announcing a Direct with around 24 hours notice.

articles.title: 'GTA 6' Hype is Sending PS5 Pro Prices Through the Roof
articles.summary: After 13 years of waiting, Grand Theft Auto 6 finally gave fans something substantial to obsess over this weekend. Rockstar's 26-minute extended look showed off Jason and Lucia's latest adventures in Vice City, along with some seriously impressive visuals, from destructible environments and…
body: The footage was captured on PS5 hardware, and the hype has already spilled over into the console market. Nobody may be more excited about GTA 6 than the third-party sellers cashing in on PS5 Pro demand.

Following the GTA 6 extended look, the PS5 Pro has become considerably harder to find at its normal price in the U.S. Major retailers have been running out of stock, leaving third-party sellers to take advantage of the sudden demand.

At Walmart and Best Buy, via TechPowerUp, third-party listings for the PS5 Pro have climbed to as high as $1,400, including a $1,299.99 listing sold and shipped by a third-party seller. That's a significant jump from the console's $899 price. In other words, if you suddenly decided that you absolutely needed a PS5 Pro because you watched Jason and Lucia drive around Vice City for 26 minutes, you might now have to pay considerably more for the privilege.

articles.title: Xbox CEO Says Making Halo Popular Again Is A Priority, But Franchise Co-Creator Questions If It’s Possible
articles.summary: The Halo franchise remains synonymous with the Xbox brand, but many might agree that it has seen better days. Xbox's new CEO, Asha Sharma, has now commented on Halo's future, saying in an interview that Halo remains a "very key franchise" for Xbox and that Microsoft is taking a long-term view about…
body: "The thing that I am learning about great games is that they have a long history and heritage and we can take a long-term view. I am confident that Halo is a very important part of our portfolio. It is a very key franchise. It represents a very key memory structure and way that people want to play," she told the BBC. "I am focused on that. We'll have more news to share on Halo going forward."

The latest entry in the Halo series was this past July's Halo: Campaign Evolved, a remaster of the 2001 original game released this year to celebrate the game's 25th anniversary. The game, which represented Halo's debut on PlayStation, was generally well-received, but apparently had a slow start for sales.
Industry analyst Rhys Elliott lamented the slowing sales and diminishing profile of Halo as a franchise in general after the series peaked, in his eyes, with Halo 3 and Halo: Reach years ago.

“One can’t help wondering what could have been if Halo had kept the trajectory it had around Halo 3 and Reach. A remake of the game that started it all landing this softly on a new platform makes me pretty sad, as a Halo fan,” he wrote.
points: The Halo franchise remains synonymous with the Xbox brand, but many might agree that it has seen better days.

articles.title: One of Elden Ring's top sleuths has already unmasked its new DLC characters
articles.summary: Longtime FromSoftware dataminer Zullie the Witch has come out with a new video showing off the close-up details of Elden Ring's two new NPC invaders. Knight Leontiel and Noble Broken Mask were both added to the game as part of Elden Ring's Tarnished Edition DLC.
body: Knight Leontiel is a straight "hey, I know them" reference to Lucatiel of Mirrah from Dark Souls 2, boasting an HD remaster of her signature conquistador fit and nimble greatsword. Take off the mask, though, and Leontiel practically is Lucatiel, even down to a burn mark over her left eye that corresponds to the hollowing rot Lucatiel suffered in Dark Souls 2.

Noble Broken Mask, meanwhile, may obliquely give us a better idea of what his base game counterpart and spiritual rival, Goldmask, is supposed to look like. Goldmask's model has a face, but it seems like a generic placeholder element. Broken Mask has an austere, pinched face with striking pale gold eyes, and Zullie points out that he bears a more than passing resemblance to the typically obscured faces of Elden Ring's perfumer enemies.
points: Longtime FromSoftware dataminer Zullie the Witch has come out with a new video showing off the close-up details of Elden Ring's two new NPC invaders.

articles.title: After the debacle of Cyberpunk 2077, CD Projekt says The Witcher 4 is already running on PC and consoles, promises 'it's going to run' on all target platforms
articles.summary: Cyberpunk 2077 now is one of the best RPGs money can buy. But Cyberpunk 2077 then, which is to say when it was new, was not. It was pretty okay on PC, aside from a horde of bugs, but it was such a performance catastrophe on the PlayStation 4 that Sony literally booted it off the PlayStation Store.
body: Speaking to Game Developer, CD Projekt Red co-CEO Michał Nowakowski said that failure arose from the studio's ambitions for the game, which led it to develop on PC first. "We want[ed] to push the boundaries of what is doable in terms of cinematic feeling and whatnot [in Cyberpunk 2077], and PC was just the best suited rig for that," Nowakowski said. "There was this, as it turned out, false belief that toning it down to whatever was the current gen is not going to be that much of a challenge."

There was also a little bit of belief in a Polish take on the ol' Bioware magic: Nowakowski said the studio "got a bit lucky here and there" with The Witcher 3, leading it to believe that Cyberpunk would ultimately be fine too.

Of course, Cyberpunk 2077 was most definitely not fine, and with that humiliation firmly burned into its collective consciousness, CD Projekt Red is approaching The Witcher 4 with a little more care and consideration to ensure the new game runs properly on all platforms it's coming to. If development hits a snag on any single platform, for instance, the studio stops to fix it rather than simply pressing ahead and coming back to clean it up later.

articles.title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword review
articles.summary: Legendary swordsman Miyamoto Musashi considered himself more an artist than a fighter. A keen strategist and a self-proclaimed master of war, I think it's Musashi's art that hits more keenly than his katana: it's minimalist, monochromatic, a study of nature defined by its simple brilliance.
body: When you're not fighting, you're exploring. Way of the Sword is neither completely linear nor open-world, but instead occasionally balloons to let you explore medium-sized areas and complete a couple of repetitive side missions. These distractions give you a better sense of the world you're trying to save from an invasion of 'genma', nefarious beings that want to conquer both the human realm and hell for all the usual reasons: power, infamy, boredom. But, honestly, I think the game would have benefitted from a more blinkered setup: the 'legacy' dungeons and severely-walled paths are for more effective uses of Onimusha's time than what often feel about dalliances around a crumbling Kyoto.
points: Legendary swordsman Miyamoto Musashi considered himself more an artist than a fighter.

videos.title: Stranded Deep 2 - Official Announcement Teaser Trailer
videos.summary: Take a look at the Stranded Deep 2 announcement teaser trailer for this upcoming survival sandbox sequel game. Standed Deep 2 will be available on PC.
body: In Stranded Deep 2, the survival sandbox expands into an unforgiving desert wilderness. Rather than being stranded in the vast expanse of the Pacific Ocean, players must now survive within a harsh landscape shaped by scorching heat, winding rivers, towering canyons and deadly wildlife, with a whole new world of biomes to explore and resources to discover. But the desert is only the beginning.

Stranded Deep 2 is a frontier exploration survival game. Players start as survivors, grow into explorers, and gradually discover that there is far more to the world than simply staying alive. At the heart of the experience is an endless river world, carving through canyons, dunes and valleys and providing a lifeline into a vast wilderness filled with danger and discovery.
points: Take a look at the Stranded Deep 2 announcement teaser trailer for this upcoming survival sandbox sequel game.
In Stranded Deep 2, the survival sandbox expands into an unforgiving desert wilderness.
Rather than being stranded in the vast expanse of the Pacific Ocean, players must now survive within a harsh landscape shaped by scorching heat, winding rivers, towering canyons and deadly wildlife…
Stranded Deep 2 is a frontier exploration survival game.
